title: Separate memory repos miss JSONL merge-driver setup and doctor checks
description: Evidence: project setup configures the JSONL merge driver in the project repo before initializing separate memory repos; doctor inspects merge-driver config only at context.workspaceRoot while separately checking memory Git paths. Impact: a separate/submodule memory repo can merge JSONL ledgers with default Git behavior while doctor reports project merge-driver health.
acceptanceCriteria: Setup and doctor configure/check the JSONL merge driver in separate or submodule memory repos, with a regression that unsets the memory repo driver only.
